clips.title: The story
paras: Bruegal Ironknuckle is an infamous dwarven prisoner held within the Stormwind Stockade. Unlike the petty criminals and rioting rabble that fill the holding cells, he is a formidable brawler whose presence deep inside the corridors spells immediate danger to anyone trying to restore order.

When the Stormwind Stockade erupted into open revolt, many of the city's most volatile cutthroats took control of the subterranean cellblocks. Among them is Bruegal Ironknuckle, a particularly dangerous dwarf inmate known for brutal brawling strength. Rather than staying confined to a single cell, he prowls the riot-torn hallways, ready to bash anyone attempting to quell the uprising.
